'''Bargos the Hutt''' was a middle-ranked [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] living on hard times in a [[Bargos' Palace|palace]] somewhere on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Biography==
Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Bargos won an [[oridium]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Bargos's mining operation|operation]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. He called in the debt of a group of adventurers to travel to [[Gavos]], a small [[Planet/Legends|planet]] just [[Core Worlds/Legends|coreward]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] where the operation was based, to assess the worth of the mines. The adventurers discovered, however, that Bargos' new mines did not produce as much oridium as expected because, while the mines contain tons of oridium, the [[Ore/Legends|ore]] was too difficult to extract to be profitable.<ref name="Review" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The image used to depict Bargos the Hutt was originally used to depict [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in the now defunct ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.
